name: Absolute Cinema
message: Treat an event as an outstanding piece of entertainment, sincerely or with playful exaggeration.
relational_pattern: Ordinary events are elevated into a grand spectacle.
example_context: The underdog won after three improbable reversals in the final minute.
near_miss_context: Someone needs practical help during an upsetting event; treating it as entertainment would be insensitive.

name: This Is Fine
message: Maintain a facade of calm while circumstances are visibly falling apart.
relational_pattern: Claimed wellbeing contradicts obvious surrounding trouble.
example_context: Three deadlines moved to today. I have decided everything is perfectly under control.
near_miss_context: Things really are going well and the speaker is sincerely relieved.

name: Monkey Puppet
message: React awkwardly while trying not to reveal knowledge or involvement.
relational_pattern: The observer has a reason to avoid attention.
example_context: Everyone is asking who finished the dessert, and I am quietly washing my spoon.
near_miss_context: The speaker has nothing to hide and wants a straightforward explanation.

name: Sad Pablo Escobar
message: Show lonely waiting, boredom, or an anticlimactic absence of activity.
relational_pattern: Expected company or stimulation is missing.
example_context: I cleared the whole evening for the game and everyone cancelled.
near_miss_context: The speaker deliberately chose solitude and is enjoying it.

name: Hide the Pain Harold
message: Keep a strained pleasant expression despite internal discomfort.
relational_pattern: Public politeness conceals private suffering.
example_context: My boss asked whether I enjoyed the four-hour meeting. I smiled and said absolutely.
near_miss_context: The person is genuinely happy rather than putting on a brave face.

name: Laughing Leo
message: Offer amused, smug disbelief at a statement or outcome.
relational_pattern: An observer finds a claim or irony particularly entertaining.
example_context: He said the software cannot have bugs because it compiled.
near_miss_context: Someone shares a painful personal failure and is not inviting a roast.

name: Leonardo DiCaprio Cheers
message: Acknowledge a win or a clever remark with a composed celebratory toast.
relational_pattern: An observer gives stylish recognition without a long speech.
example_context: After months of work, the first customer finally paid.
near_miss_context: The person is requesting urgent instructions rather than celebration.

name: Waiting Skeleton
message: Exaggerate how long an anticipated response or event is taking.
relational_pattern: A supposedly brief delay stretches beyond patience.
example_context: They said they would send the invite in five minutes. That was last week.
near_miss_context: The wait is normal, short, and explicitly expected.

name: Squidward Window
message: Look on wistfully while others enjoy something you are excluded from.
relational_pattern: An observer watches other people have the desired experience.
example_context: Everyone is out playing while I wait at home for the delivery.
near_miss_context: The speaker dislikes the activity and is glad not to participate.

name: Charlie Conspiracy
message: Dramatize an elaborate explanation built from many connected details.
relational_pattern: A sprawling theory is offered with intense conviction.
example_context: I have six spreadsheets explaining why the cafeteria changed its menu.
near_miss_context: A short, ordinary explanation with straightforward evidence.

name: Spider-Man Pointing
message: Recognize matching identities, behaviour, or mutual accusations.
relational_pattern: Two parties mirror the same relevant property.
example_context: Two services each claim the other one is responsible for authentication.
near_miss_context: One party has a clearly different role and there is no symmetry.

name: It's a Trap!
message: Warn that an apparently attractive invitation has a hidden downside.
relational_pattern: A tempting offer conceals a catch.
example_context: The free trial asks for a card and renews at an expensive annual rate.
near_miss_context: The invitation is transparent and has no concealed condition.

name: Ain't Nobody Got Time for That
message: Reject an activity because it is not worth the effort or time.
relational_pattern: A requested effort exceeds willingness to engage.
example_context: To unsubscribe, they want me to print a form and mail it.
near_miss_context: Someone needs genuine urgent support rather than a dismissive joke.

name: Do You Want Ants?
message: Point out that someone's behaviour invites the predictable problem they want to avoid.
relational_pattern: Carelessness creates its own foreseeable consequence.
example_context: He posts the meeting link publicly and then wonders why strangers join.
near_miss_context: The cause of the problem is unknown or the person is not responsible.

name: Life Finds a Way
message: Marvel at something persisting or succeeding despite obstacles.
relational_pattern: An unlikely path emerges after obvious paths are blocked.
example_context: The team ran out of tools and still built a working solution from spare parts.
near_miss_context: An ordinary task succeeds exactly as planned without obstacles.

name: Milk Was a Bad Choice
message: Admit regret after an ill-judged choice backfires.
relational_pattern: The actor recognizes their own decision was the mistake.
example_context: I drank a giant coffee at midnight and now it is four in the morning.
near_miss_context: The decision was sensible and the outcome was entirely outside their control.

name: It Ain't Much, But It's Honest Work
message: Take modest pride in a small but useful contribution.
relational_pattern: A humble result is worthwhile despite its limited scale.
example_context: I fixed one typo in a huge documentation site today.
near_miss_context: The achievement is enormous or the contribution is actually harmful.

name: Why Shouldn't I Keep It?
message: Rationalize keeping or indulging in something one intended to give up.
relational_pattern: Desire quietly rewrites a prior commitment.
example_context: I planned to sell the old laptop, but now I am inventing reasons to keep it.
near_miss_context: There was never a plan or reason to let the object go.

name: What's in the Box?
message: Exaggerate suspense or anxious curiosity about hidden contents.
relational_pattern: Something withheld becomes the focus of intense anticipation.
example_context: My friend keeps saying they have news but refuses to say what it is.
near_miss_context: The information is already known and there is nothing being withheld.

name: I Was Told There Would Be Cake
message: Complain that an advertised benefit or incentive never materialized.
relational_pattern: Participation was motivated by an expectation that was not met.
example_context: I joined the workshop for the promised hands-on practice. It was all slides.
near_miss_context: Nobody promised the benefit and the expectation was invented afterward.

name: I Am the Captain Now
message: Announce taking control or reversing the usual hierarchy.
relational_pattern: The previously subordinate party claims authority.
example_context: The intern fixed the outage and is now assigning everyone follow-up tasks.
near_miss_context: The established leader is simply continuing their usual role.

name: A Center for Ants?
message: Mock something being far smaller than its intended purpose requires.
relational_pattern: The offered scale is absurdly inadequate.
example_context: They booked a four-seat room for a team of twenty.
near_miss_context: The item is a deliberate miniature or is appropriately sized.

name: You Were the Chosen One!
message: Express theatrical disappointment when a trusted hope becomes part of the problem.
relational_pattern: The expected solution betrays the role assigned to it.
example_context: The app I installed to reduce distractions now sends the most notifications.
near_miss_context: An unrelated new product disappoints without any prior expectation of rescue.

name: I Feel Like I'm Taking Crazy Pills
message: Express disbelief that everyone else is accepting an obvious absurdity.
relational_pattern: One observer cannot reconcile a group's consensus with what seems apparent.
example_context: Everyone is celebrating the new shorter meetings, which now happen twice as often.
near_miss_context: The person is discussing genuine mental-health symptoms.

name: You Sit on a Throne of Lies
message: Playfully reject an obviously dubious claim.
relational_pattern: Confident words conflict with evidence already available to the group.
example_context: He says he was not eating the biscuits while still holding the empty packet.
near_miss_context: The person is making a sincere disclosure that you have no reason to doubt.

name: Stop Trying to Make Fetch Happen
message: Push back on someone repeatedly trying to force an idea or phrase into acceptance.
relational_pattern: Persistence has become an attempt to manufacture agreement.
example_context: For the sixth week in a row, he is trying to make everyone use his new nickname.
near_miss_context: Someone is making a reasonable first attempt at a new idea.

name: First Try!
message: Celebrate a success, potentially while jokingly hiding all the failed attempts.
relational_pattern: The visible success conceals a less glamorous attempt history.
example_context: After forty failed test runs, it finally passed. I announce that it worked immediately.
near_miss_context: The audience needs an accurate accounting of how many attempts occurred.

name: Michael Scott No God No
message: Reject unwelcome news with exaggerated dread.
relational_pattern: An anticipated inconvenience provokes a theatrical negative reaction.
example_context: They have announced another compulsory weekend team-building session.
near_miss_context: The user is sharing a sensitive event that needs a calm, supportive reply.

name: Shut Up and Take My Money!
message: Express immediate enthusiasm for a product or proposal.
relational_pattern: Desire is strong enough that further persuasion is unnecessary.
example_context: Someone demonstrated a gadget that solves the exact annoyance I complain about daily.
near_miss_context: The purchase would be risky and the user is requesting careful advice.

name: Facepalm
message: React with embarrassed exasperation to an avoidable mistake.
relational_pattern: An obvious error is difficult to watch without reacting.
example_context: I spent ten minutes looking for the glasses that were on my head.
near_miss_context: A beginner asks a reasonable question and is trying to learn.

name: Surprised Pikachu
message: Express ironic surprise at a predictable result, especially after ignoring a warning.
relational_pattern: A chosen action produces its foreseeable consequence.
example_context: I ignored every low-battery warning and now the laptop shut down. How could this happen?
near_miss_context: The outcome was genuinely unforeseeable; mocking surprise would miss the point.

name: You Guys Are Getting Paid?
message: Reveal that one person lacks even the basic benefit others are comparing.
relational_pattern: A comparison exposes a more fundamental disparity.
example_context: Everyone is debating how big their bonuses were. I did the same work unpaid.
near_miss_context: The speaker already has the same benefit and is merely comparing amounts.

name: They're The Same Picture
message: Dismiss a supposedly meaningful distinction between two things.
relational_pattern: Two presented alternatives are equivalent in the relevant respect.
example_context: They replaced the mandatory meeting with a mandatory alignment session.
near_miss_context: The alternatives differ materially in the way the conversation cares about.

name: Drake Hotline Bling
message: Reject one option and enthusiastically prefer another, often for an ironic reason.
relational_pattern: A paired contrast makes the preference clear.
example_context: Reading a two-page guide? No. Spending an hour searching for a video? Yes.
near_miss_context: There is no pair of options or meaningful preference to contrast.

name: Two Buttons
message: Show an uncomfortable choice between conflicting goals or commitments.
relational_pattern: Two desired positions cannot both be maintained.
example_context: I want fewer notifications, but I also want to know every update immediately.
near_miss_context: Both choices can easily be taken without any conflict.

name: Distracted Boyfriend
message: Show attention drifting from an existing commitment to a tempting alternative.
relational_pattern: A committed actor is distracted by a newer attraction.
example_context: I opened the editor to finish one project and immediately started a new one.
near_miss_context: The person has no existing commitment or competing attraction.

name: Gru's Plan
message: Present a confident plan that contains the seed of its own failure.
relational_pattern: The planner discovers a self-defeating step in their own plan.
example_context: I disabled all reminders to improve focus, then forgot the appointment I was focusing on.
near_miss_context: A sound plan failed because of a completely unrelated external event.

name: Anakin Padme 4 Panel
message: Begin with a benign interpretation, then become worried when reassurance does not arrive.
relational_pattern: A statement admits an alarming interpretation that remains uncorrected.
example_context: We removed the login requirement. Only on the demo environment, right? Right?
near_miss_context: The speaker immediately confirms a harmless explanation.

name: Trade Offer
message: Expose the imbalance or absurdity of an exchange.
relational_pattern: What one party gives and receives makes the bargain questionable.
example_context: They want a full weekend of work in exchange for exposure.
near_miss_context: The exchange is balanced and nobody is questioning its terms.

name: Pawn Stars Best I Can Do
message: Counter an ambitious request with a dramatically smaller offer.
relational_pattern: Expectation and available offer are far apart.
example_context: Can you give me the full product by tonight? I can give you the login screen.
near_miss_context: The speaker can and intends to fully meet the request.

name: Bike Fall
message: Show someone causing their own problem and then complaining or blaming elsewhere.
relational_pattern: The actor creates the obstacle that hurts them.
example_context: I muted the group chat and now I am annoyed nobody told me the plan.
near_miss_context: The person had no role in causing the problem.

name: Evil Kermit
message: Contrast a sensible intention with a tempting, worse inner suggestion.
relational_pattern: Internal temptation argues against the original sensible plan.
example_context: I should go to bed. Or I could start a three-hour movie.
near_miss_context: Both voices are giving equally sensible advice.

name: Roll Safe Think About It
message: Present a superficially clever workaround that dodges the real objective.
relational_pattern: Avoiding a problem technically also forfeits the desired benefit.
example_context: You cannot fail an exam if you never register for it.
near_miss_context: The workaround actually solves the problem without sacrificing the goal.

name: Clown Applying Makeup
message: Show increasingly implausible rationalizations or misplaced confidence.
relational_pattern: Each added justification makes the position harder to defend.
example_context: They missed every deadline, but this time their announcement says definitely.
near_miss_context: New evidence genuinely strengthens a reasonable position.

name: X, X Everywhere
message: Point out that the same thing appears to be everywhere.
relational_pattern: A repeated pattern dominates the observer's surroundings.
example_context: Every new app I opened today has added the same chatbot button.
near_miss_context: The conversation concerns a single isolated occurrence.

name: Is This A Pigeon
message: Highlight a confident or naive misidentification.
relational_pattern: An observed thing is assigned a clearly mismatched label.
example_context: They renamed unpaid overtime as a personal growth opportunity.
near_miss_context: The label accurately captures the thing being described.

name: Woman Yelling At Cat
message: Contrast an intense complaint with an unmoved or confused recipient.
relational_pattern: Two sides react to the same dispute with very different intensity.
example_context: I am furious about the budget. The cat is wondering when dinner is.
near_miss_context: Both participants are calmly working through the same explanation.

name: Expanding Brain
message: Escalate an idea through increasingly grand or absurd levels.
relational_pattern: A ranked sequence exaggerates intellectual sophistication.
example_context: First we wrote a list, then an app, then a platform just to remember groceries.
near_miss_context: Only one idea is offered and there is no escalation.

name: Tuxedo Winnie The Pooh
message: Contrast ordinary wording or taste with an unnecessarily refined version.
relational_pattern: The same basic thing is presented as suddenly sophisticated.
example_context: Leftovers became an artisanal next-day tasting menu.
near_miss_context: The expensive version has a genuinely different function.

name: Buff Doge vs Cheems
message: Exaggerate the contrast between confidence or capability in two settings.
relational_pattern: A strong self-image in one setting shrinks in another.
example_context: Me explaining the design in my head versus answering the first question aloud.
near_miss_context: There is no meaningful contrast in confidence or capability.

name: Left Exit 12 Off Ramp
message: Show a sudden diversion away from the sensible route toward temptation.
relational_pattern: An actor abruptly abandons the expected direction.
example_context: I was on my way to buy vegetables and saw the bakery sign.
near_miss_context: The changed plan follows a calm decision based on new information.

name: UNO Draw 25 Cards
message: Show someone accepting a large penalty rather than doing a simple unwanted action.
relational_pattern: Avoidance is so strong that a worse alternative is chosen.
example_context: I would rather rewrite the whole module than ask where the config file is.
near_miss_context: The supposedly simple action is genuinely dangerous or unreasonable.

name: Flex Tape
message: Apply a visibly small patch to a disproportionately large underlying problem.
relational_pattern: A superficial fix is presented as adequate for a major issue.
example_context: The app crashes daily, so the update adds a friendlier error message.
near_miss_context: A small patch genuinely resolves a small localized defect.

name: Domino Effect
message: Trace an outsized final result back to a tiny initial trigger.
relational_pattern: A chain of consequences amplifies a small starting event.
example_context: One innocent question led to a new project, a new team, and a new office.
near_miss_context: The events are unrelated rather than causally connected.

name: Boardroom Meeting Suggestion
message: Expose a group rewarding acceptable nonsense and rejecting the useful obvious answer.
relational_pattern: A sensible proposal threatens the group's preferred assumptions.
example_context: They requested ideas to reduce meetings and rejected the suggestion to cancel one.
near_miss_context: The rejected suggestion has a clear practical flaw.

name: The Scroll Of Truth
message: Reject a truth precisely because it is unwelcome.
relational_pattern: An actor seeks an answer and discards it when it contradicts their wishes.
example_context: I asked what would improve my mornings. They said go to bed earlier. I demand another answer.
near_miss_context: The answer is false or unsupported and deserves rejection.

name: Panik Kalm Panik
message: Move from alarm to relief and back to alarm as more information arrives.
relational_pattern: A reassuring interpretation is overturned by a second revelation.
example_context: The file is missing. There is a backup. The backup is the missing file.
near_miss_context: The reassuring information actually resolves the concern permanently.

name: AJ Styles and Undertaker
message: Show someone feeling secure while an unnoticed threat or consequence approaches.
relational_pattern: The audience sees what the confident actor has not noticed.
example_context: I finished my tasks early, unaware that three meeting invites had just arrived.
near_miss_context: The actor is already fully aware of the approaching problem.

name: This Is Where I'd Put My Trophy If I Had One
message: Dramatically point out the absence of something expected or desired.
relational_pattern: A prepared place emphasizes a missing achievement or resource.
example_context: Here is the dashboard for our paying users. There are none yet.
near_miss_context: The desired thing is present; only its quality is in question.

name: Afraid to Ask Andy
message: Admit a knowledge gap that has become awkward to reveal after pretending to follow along.
relational_pattern: Delayed clarification creates social embarrassment.
example_context: I have attended six meetings and still do not know what the project acronym means.
near_miss_context: The person is asking early and comfortably, without any social hesitation.
